newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Turkish banks started by Caspian. [CORRECTED 22:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Turkish banks started by Caspian. [CORRECTED 22:00 GMT]

text.p: Caspian Securities said Tuesday analysts Damon Palmer and Rousham Arumugam had started coverage of four Turkish banks.
In a May 23 report, Palmer and Arumugam started Garanti Bank and Yapi ve Kredi Bank (corrects name) with ratings of buy.
"Yapi ve Kredi ... is the most attractively valued of the major Turkish banks on almost all valuation parameters," they said.
"We expect that Garanti will be one of the most profitable of the major Turkish banks in coming years."
They rated Akbank TAS a market performer.
"Akbank has proven it is capable of delivering strong profitability in Turkey's often-volatile banking environment," they said.
The analysts started coverage of Isbank, Turkey's largest listed bank, with a sell rating.
"We believe it has less room to gain market share or to enter new financial service areas than many of its listed competitors."
